all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ يَأۡتِ لَا تَكَلَّمُ نَفۡسٌ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِهِۦۚ فَمِنۡهُمۡ شَقِيࣱّ وَسَعِيدࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: The Day it comes no soul will speak except by His permission. And among them will be the wretched and the prosperous.
translations.pickthall: On the day when it cometh no soul will speak except by His permission; some among them will be wretched, (others) glad.
translations.khattab: When that Day arrives, no one will dare speak except with His permission. Some of them will be miserable, others joyful
translations.arberry: the day it comes, no soul shall speak save by His leave; some of them shall be wretched and some happy.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ شَقُواْ فَفِي ٱلنَّارِ لَهُمۡ فِيهَا زَفِيرࣱ وَشَهِيقٌ

translations.saheeh: As for those who were [destined to be] wretched, they will be in the Fire. For them therein is [violent] exhaling and inhaling.
translations.pickthall: As for those who will be wretched (on that day) they will be in the Fire; sighing and wailing will be their portion therein,
translations.khattab: As for those bound for misery, they will be in the Fire, where they will be sighing and gasping
translations.arberry: As for the wretched, they shall be in the Fire, wherein there shall be for them moaning and sighing, therein dwelling forever,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي وَهَنَ ٱلۡعَظۡمُ مِنِّي وَٱشۡتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأۡسُ شَيۡبࣰ ا وَلَمۡ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيࣰّ ا

translations.saheeh: He said, "My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy.
translations.pickthall: Saying: My Lord! Lo! the bones of me wax feeble and my head is shining with grey hair, and I have never been unblest in prayer to Thee, my Lord.
translations.khattab: saying, “My Lord! Surely my bones have become brittle, and grey hair has spread across my head, but I have never been disappointed in my prayer to You, my Lord
translations.arberry: saying, 'O my Lord, behold the bones within me are feeble and my head is all aflame with hoariness. And in calling on Thee, my Lord, I have never been hitherto unprosperous.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَبَرَّۢا بِوَٰلِدَتِي وَلَمۡ يَجۡعَلۡنِي جَبَّارࣰ ا شَقِيࣰّ ا

translations.saheeh: And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant.
translations.pickthall: And (hath made me) dutiful toward her who bore me, and hath not made me arrogant, unblest.
translations.khattab: and to be kind to my mother. He has not made me arrogant or defiant
translations.arberry: and likewise to cherish my mother; He has not made me arrogant, unprosperous.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَأَعۡتَزِلُكُمۡ وَمَا تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدۡعُواْ رَبِّي عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّي شَقِيࣰّ ا

translations.saheeh: And I will leave you and those you invoke other than Allah and will invoke my Lord. I expect that I will not be in invocation to my Lord unhappy."
translations.pickthall: I shall withdraw from you and that unto which ye pray beside Allah, and I shall pray unto my Lord. It may be that, in prayer unto my Lord, I shall not be unblest.
translations.khattab: As I distance myself from ˹all of˺ you and from whatever you invoke besides Allah, I will ˹continue to˺ call upon my Lord ˹alone˺, trusting that I will never be disappointed in invoking my Lord.”
translations.arberry: Now I will go apart from you and that you call upon, apart from God; I will call upon my Lord, and haply I shall not be, in calling upon my Lord, unprosperous.

translations.saheeh: We have not sent down to you the Qur'an that you be distressed
translations.pickthall: We have not revealed unto thee (Muhammad) this Qur'an that thou shouldst be distressed,
translations.khattab: We have not revealed the Quran to you ˹O Prophet˺ to cause you distress
translations.arberry: We have not sent down the Koran upon thee for thee to be unprosperous,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَقُلۡنَا يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ إِنَّ هَٰذَا عَدُوࣱّ لَّكَ وَلِزَوۡجِكَ فَلَا يُخۡرِجَنَّكُمَا مِنَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ فَتَشۡقَىٰٓ

translations.saheeh: So We said, "O Adam, indeed this is an enemy to you and to your wife. Then let him not remove you from Paradise so you would suffer.
translations.pickthall: Therefor we said: O Adam! This is an enemy unto thee and unto thy wife, so let him not drive you both out of the Garden so that thou come to toil.
translations.khattab: So We cautioned, “O Adam! This is surely an enemy to you and to your wife. So do not let him drive you both out of Paradise, for you ˹O Adam˺ would then suffer ˹hardship˺
translations.arberry: Then We said, 'Adam, surely this is an enemy to thee and thy wife. So let him not expel you both from the Garden, so that thou art unprosperous.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: قَالَ ٱهۡبِطَا مِنۡهَا جَمِيعَۢاۖ بَعۡضُكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوࣱّۖ فَإِمَّا يَأۡتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّي هُدࣰ ى فَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ هُدَايَ فَلَا يَضِلُّ وَلَا يَشۡقَىٰ

translations.saheeh: [Allah] said, "Descend from Paradise - all, [your descendants] being enemies to one another. And if there should come to you guidance from Me - then whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray [in the world] nor suffer [in the Hereafter].
translations.pickthall: He said: Go down hence, both of you, one of you a foe unto the other. But when there come unto you from Me a guidance, then whoso followeth My guidance, he will not go astray nor come to grief.
translations.khattab: Allah said, “Descend, both of you, from here together ˹with Satan˺ as enemies to each other. Then when guidance comes to you from Me, whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray ˹in this life˺ nor suffer ˹in the next˺
translations.arberry: Said He, 'Get you down, both of you together, out of it, each of you an enemy to each; but if there comes to you from Me guidance, then whosoever follows My guidance shall not go astray, neither shall he be unprosperous;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتۡ عَلَيۡنَا شِقۡوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوۡمࣰ ا ضَآلِّينَ

translations.saheeh: They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray.
translations.pickthall: They will say: Our Lord! Our evil fortune conquered us, and we were erring folk.
translations.khattab: They will cry, “Our Lord! Our ill-fate took hold of us, so we became a misguided people
translations.arberry: They shall say, 'Our Lord, our adversity prevailed over us; we were an erring people.

translations.saheeh: But the wretched one will avoid it -
translations.pickthall: But the most hapless will flout it,
translations.khattab: But it will be shunned by the most wretched
translations.arberry: but the most wretched shall flout it,

translations.saheeh: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.
translations.pickthall: When the basest of them broke forth
translations.khattab: when the most wicked of them was roused ˹to kill the she-camel˺
translations.arberry: when the most wretched of them uprose,

translations.saheeh: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one.
translations.pickthall: Which only the most wretched must endure,
translations.khattab: in which none will burn except the most wretched—
translations.arberry: whereat none but the most wretched shall be roasted,
